note: Input byte controls compression level and therefore the compression path and output sizing behavior.
The chosen chunk size is passed into the super-chunk append path as the source buffer length.

code: int cbytes = blosc2_compress_ctx(schunk->cctx, src, nbytes, chunk, nbytes + BLOSC2_MAX_OVERHEAD);
note: The compressor is asked to write into a buffer sized only for the nominal input plus overhead; the violated obligation is that the produced compressed size must stay below the allocated destination capacity.
The threaded compression job returns after the underlying compression routine has already performed the invalid write that ASan reports in do_job.
